descriptions.notStarted: Could it be...? Is it really the VIP Zone in Kerning Square? Rush over to #bJune#k!
descriptions.inProgress: He says he'll let you enter the VIP Zone if you bring him VIP Tickets. He says you can get them from any monster in Kerning Square.
descriptions.completed: He says the VIP Zone can be entered once every 30 minutes. Go see #bJune#k when the 30 minutes are up.
